# SkoolTrack

> Multi-tenant K-12 school SaaS for attendance, report cards, credits/billing, and parent messaging. https://skooltrack.in

SkoolTrack is a role-based web application with three roles: super admin (platform), principal (school admin), and teacher. Authentication is email + password (Supabase). After signing in at /login you are routed to /dashboard; the sidebar navigation adapts to your role. All data is row-level-security scoped by school and role.

## Key routes
- /login — sign in (email + password). Demo accounts are listed on this screen.
- /dashboard — role-aware overview
- /schools — (super admin) manage schools, logos, status, credits
- /credits — (super admin) credit management + approve principal requests
- /analytics — (super admin) attendance & performance analytics with filters
- /students — (principal) student roster, CSV import/export, detail pages
- /teachers — (principal) teacher roster
- /classes — (principal) classes, view students, student promotion
- /subjects — (principal) subject catalog
- /attendance — (principal) attendance records + classroom photo proof
- /mark-attendance — (teacher) mark daily attendance with a live camera photo
- /my-class — (teacher) class roster, student info, messaging
- /report-cards — report cards with PDF download and template selection
- /messages — parent WhatsApp alerts, custom messages, staff notices
- /holidays — holiday calendar (pauses attendance, optional parent notify)
- /billing — (principal) credit balance, history, request top-ups
- /logs — activity / audit logs (who did what, when, IP)
- /settings — account and workspace settings

## Notes for automated agents
- Navigate by following sidebar links; each list page has search and CSV export.
- Report cards and most tables can be exported (CSV) or printed to PDF.
- Writes are authorized server-side by Supabase RLS; unauthorized actions return 403.
